    52→    selected_tier: int | None
    53→    fallback_reason: str | None
    54→    available_tiers: list[int]
    55→    grouped: dict[str, list[dict]]
    56→
    57→
    58→def _apply_plan_order(
    59→    items: list[dict],
    60→    plan: dict,
    61→    *,
    62→    include_skipped: bool = False,
    63→    cluster: str | None = None,
    64→) -> list[dict]:
    65→    """Reorder items according to the living plan.
    66→
    67→    1. Items in ``queue_order`` appear first, in that order.
    68→    2. Remaining items keep their mechanical sort.
    69→    3. Skipped items are appended last (or excluded).
    70→    4. Each item is annotated with plan metadata.
    71→    """
    72→    queue_order: list[str] = plan.get("queue_order", [])
    73→    skipped_map: dict = plan.get("skipped", {})
    74→    skipped_ids: set[str] = set(skipped_map.keys())
    75→    overrides: dict = plan.get("overrides", {})
    76→    clusters: dict = plan.get("clusters", {})
    77→    active_cluster = plan.get("active_cluster")
    78→
    79→    # Build lookup
    80→    by_id: dict[str, dict] = {}
    81→    for item in items:
    82→        by_id[item["id"]] = item
    83→
    84→    # Annotate items with plan metadata
    85→    for item_id, item in by_id.items():
    86→        override = overrides.get(item_id, {})
    87→        if override.get("description"):
    88→            item["plan_description"] = override["description"]
    89→        if override.get("note"):
    90→            item["plan_note"] = override["note"]
    91→        if override.get("cluster"):
    92→            cluster_name = override["cluster"]
    93→            cluster_data = clusters.get(cluster_name, {})
    94→            item["plan_cluster"] = {
    95→                "name": cluster_name,
    96→                "description": cluster_data.get("description"),
    97→                "total_items": len(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", [])),
    98→                "sibling_ids": cluster_data.get("finding_ids", []),
    99→            }
   100→
   101→    # Split into ordered, remaining, skipped
   102→    ordered: list[dict] = []
   103→    ordered_ids: set[str] = set()
   104→    for fid in queue_order:
   105→        if fid in by_id and fid not in skipped_ids:
   106→            ordered.append(by_id[fid])
   107→            ordered_ids.add(fid)
   108→
   109→    skipped_items: list[dict] = []
   110→    remaining: list[dict] = []
   111→    for item in items:
   112→        item_id = item["id"]
   113→        if item_id in ordered_ids:
   114→            continue
   115→        if item_id in skipped_ids:
   116→            skipped_items.append(item)
   117→        else:
   118→            remaining.append(item)
   119→
   120→    # Assign queue positions
   121→    result = ordered + remaining
   122→    if include_skipped:
   123→        result = result + skipped_items
   124→
   125→    for pos, item in enumerate(result):
   126→        item["queue_position"] = pos + 1
   127→        if item["id"] in skipped_ids:
   128→            item["plan_skipped"] = True
   129→            skip_entry = skipped_map.get(item["id"])
   130→            if skip_entry:
   131→                item["plan_skip_kind"] = skip_entry.get("kind", "temporary")
   132→                skip_reason = skip_entry.get("reason")
   133→                if skip_reason:
   134→                    item["plan_skip_reason"] = skip_reason
   135→
   136→    # Filter to cluster if requested
   137→    effective_cluster = cluster or active_cluster
   138→    if effective_cluster:
   139→        cluster_data = clusters.get(effective_cluster, {})
   140→        cluster_member_ids = set(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", []))
   141→        if cluster_member_ids:
   142→            result = [item for item in result if item["id"] in cluster_member_ids]
   143→
   144→    return result
   145→
   146→
   147→def _item_matches_tier(item: dict, tier: int) -> bool:
   148→    """Check if an item (or any of its members for clusters) matches a tier."""
   149→    if item.get("kind") == "cluster":
   150→        return any(
   151→            int(m.get("effective_tier", m.get("tier", 3))) == tier
   152→            for m in item.get("members", [])
   153→        )
   154→    return int(item.get("effective_tier", item.get("tier", 3))) == tier
   155→
   156→
   157→def _action_type_for_detector(detector: str) -> str:
   158→    """Look up the action_type for a detector from the registry."""
   159→    try:
   160→        from desloppify.base.registry import DETECTORS
   161→        meta = DETECTORS.get(detector)
   162→        if meta:
   163→            return meta.action_type
   164→    except ImportError:
   165→        pass
   166→    return "manual_fix"
   167→
   168→
   169→_ACTION_TYPE_PRIORITY = {"auto_fix": 0, "reorganize": 1, "refactor": 2, "manual_fix": 3}
   170→
   171→
   172→def _collapse_clusters(items: list[dict], plan: dict) -> list[dict]:
   173→    """Replace cluster member items with single cluster meta-items."""
   174→    clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
   175→    if not clusters:
   176→        return items
   177→
   178→    # Build mapping: finding_id → auto-cluster name
   179→    fid_to_cluster: dict[str, str] = {}
   180→    for name, cluster in clusters.items():
   181→        if not cluster.get("auto"):
   182→            continue
   183→        for fid in cluster.get("finding_ids", []):
   184→            fid_to_cluster[fid] = name
   185→
   186→    if not fid_to_cluster:
   187→        return items
   188→
   189→    # Collect members for each cluster, preserving order
   190→    cluster_members: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
   191→    non_cluster_items: list[dict] = []
   192→
   193→    for item in items:
   194→        cname = fid_to_cluster.get(item.get("id", ""))
   195→        if cname:
   196→            cluster_members.setdefault(cname, []).append(item)
   197→        else:
   198→            non_cluster_items.append(item)
   199→
   200→    # Build cluster meta-items
   201→    result: list[dict] = list(non_cluster_items)
   202→    for cname, members in cluster_members.items():
   203→        # Don't collapse singletons — show them as individual findings
   204→        if len(members) < 2:
   205→            result.extend(members)
   206→            continue
   207→        cluster_data = clusters.get(cname, {})
   208→        detector = members[0].get("detector", "") if members else ""
   209→        action = cluster_data.get("action") or ""
   210→        # Derive action_type from the actual cluster action, not just the detector
   211→        if cname in ("auto/initial-review", "auto/stale-review"):
   212→            action_type = "initial_review"
   213→        elif "desloppify fix" in action:
   214→            action_type = "auto_fix"
   215→        elif "desloppify move" in action:
   216→            action_type = "reorganize"
   217→        else:
   218→            action_type = _action_type_for_detector(detector)
   219→            # If detector says auto_fix but cluster has no fix command, it's really refactor
   220→            if action_type == "auto_fix" and "desloppify fix" not in action:
   221→                action_type = "refactor"
   222→
   223→        # Use stored description but patch the count if it differs from visible members
   224→        stored_desc = cluster_data.get("description") or ""
   225→        total_in_cluster = len(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", []))
   226→        if stored_desc and total_in_cluster != len(members):
   227→            # Replace the stored count with the visible count
   228→            summary = stored_desc.replace(str(total_in_cluster), str(len(members)))
   229→        else:
   230→            summary = stored_desc or f"{len(members)} findings"
   231→
   232→        primary_command = cluster_data.get("action")
   233→        if not primary_command:
   234→            primary_command = f"desloppify next --cluster {cname} --count 10"
   235→
   236→        meta_item: dict = {
   237→            "id": cname,
   238→            "kind": "cluster",
   239→            "action_type": action_type,
   240→            "summary": summary,
   241→            "members": members,
   242→            "member_count": len(members),
   243→            "primary_command": primary_command,
   244→            "cluster_name": cname,
   245→            "cluster_auto": True,
   246→            "confidence": "high",
   247→            "detector": detector,
   248→            "file": "",
   249→        }
   250→        result.append(meta_item)
   251→
   252→    result.sort(key=item_sort_key)
   253→    return result
   254→
   255→
   256→def build_work_queue(
   257→    state: StateModel,
   258→    *,
   259→    options: QueueBuildOptions | None = None,
   260→) -> WorkQueueResult:
   261→    """Build ranked queue items + tier metadata."""
   262→    resolved_options = options or QueueBuildOptions()
   263→
   264→    status = resolved_options.status
   265→    if status not in ALL_STATUSES:
   266→        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported status filter: {status}")
   267→    try:
   268→        subjective_threshold_value = float(resolved_options.subjective_threshold)
   269→    except (TypeError, ValueError):
   270→        subjective_threshold_value = 100.0
   271→    subjective_threshold_value = max(0.0, min(100.0, subjective_threshold_value))
   272→
   273→    finding_items = build_finding_items(
   274→        state,
   275→        scan_path=resolved_options.scan_path,
   276→        status_filter=status,
   277→        scope=resolved_options.scope,
   278→        chronic=resolved_options.chronic,
   279→    )
   280→
   281→    all_items = list(finding_items)
   282→    if (
   283→        resolved_options.include_subjective
   284→        and status in {"open", "all"}
   285→        and not resolved_options.chronic
   286→    ):
   287→        subjective_items = build_subjective_items(
   288→            state,
   289→            state.get("findings", {}),
   290→            threshold=subjective_threshold_value,
   291→        )
   292→        for item in subjective_items:
   293→            if scope_matches(item, resolved_options.scope):
   294→                all_items.append(item)
   295→
   296→    all_items.sort(key=item_sort_key)
   297→
   298→    # Apply living plan ordering if provided
   299→    if resolved_options.plan:
   300→        all_items = _apply_plan_order(
   301→            all_items,
   302→            resolved_options.plan,
   303→            include_skipped=resolved_options.include_skipped,
   304→            cluster=resolved_options.cluster,
   305→        )
   306→
   307→    # Collapse auto-clusters into meta-items (unless drilling into a cluster)
   308→    should_collapse = (
   309→        resolved_options.collapse_clusters
   310→        and resolved_options.plan
   311→        and not resolved_options.cluster
   312→        and not resolved_options.plan.get("active_cluster")
   313→    )
   314→    if should_collapse:
   315→        all_items = _collapse_clusters(all_items, resolved_options.plan)
   316→
   317→    counts = tier_counts(all_items)
   318→
   319→    requested_tier = (
   320→        int(resolved_options.tier) if resolved_options.tier is not None else None
   321→    )
   322→    selected_tier = requested_tier
   323→    fallback_reason = None
   324→    filtered = all_items
   325→
   326→    if requested_tier is not None:
   327→        filtered = [
   328→            item
   329→            for item in all_items
   330→            if _item_matches_tier(item, requested_tier)
   331→        ]
   332→        if not filtered and not resolved_options.no_tier_fallback:
   333→            chosen = choose_fallback_tier(requested_tier, counts)
   334→            if chosen is not None:
   335→                selected_tier = chosen
   336→                filtered = [
   337→                    item
   338→                    for item in all_items
   339→                    if _item_matches_tier(item, chosen)
   340→                ]
   341→                fallback_reason = (
   342→                    f"Requested T{requested_tier} has 0 open -> showing T{chosen} "
   343→                    "(nearest non-empty)."
   344→                )
   345→        elif not filtered:
   346→            fallback_reason = f"Requested T{requested_tier} has 0 open."
   347→
   348→    total = len(filtered)
   349→    if resolved_options.count is not None and resolved_options.count > 0:
   350→        filtered = filtered[: resolved_options.count]
   351→
   352→    if resolved_options.explain:
   353→        for item in filtered:
   354→            item["explain"] = item_explain(item)
   355→
   356→    available_tiers = [tier for tier, value in counts.items() if value > 0]
   357→    return {
   358→        "items": filtered,
   359→        "total": total,
   360→        "tier_counts": counts,
   361→        "requested_tier": requested_tier,
   362→        "selected_tier": selected_tier,
   363→        "fallback_reason": fallback_reason,
   364→        "available_tiers": available_tiers,
   365→        "grouped": group_queue_items(filtered, "item"),
   366→    }
   367→
   368→

   371→    "QueueBuildOptions",
   372→    "WorkQueueResult",

    20→def _compute_fp_rates(findings: dict) -> dict[tuple[str, str], float]:
    21→    """Compute false_positive rate per (detector, zone) from historical findings."""
    22→    counts: dict[tuple[str, str], dict[str, int]] = {}
    23→    for finding in findings.values():
    24→        detector = finding.get("detector", "unknown")
    25→        if detector in STRUCTURAL_MERGE:
    26→            detector = "structural"
    27→        zone = finding.get("zone", "production")
    28→        key = (detector, zone)
    29→        if key not in counts:
    30→            counts[key] = {"total": 0, "fp": 0}
    31→        counts[key]["total"] += 1
    32→        if finding.get("status") == "false_positive":
    33→            counts[key]["fp"] += 1
    34→
    35→    rates: dict[tuple[str, str], float] = {}
    36→    for key, stat in counts.items():
    37→        if stat["total"] >= 5 and stat["fp"] > 0:
    38→            rates[key] = stat["fp"] / stat["total"]
    39→    return rates
    40→
    41→
    42→def _auto_fixer_reminder(actions: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
    43→    auto_fix_actions = [
    44→        action for action in actions if action.get("type") == "auto_fix"
    45→    ]
    46→    if not auto_fix_actions:
    47→        return []
    48→    total = sum(action.get("count", 0) for action in auto_fix_actions)
    49→    if total <= 0:
    50→        return []
    51→    first_cmd = auto_fix_actions[0].get("command", "desloppify fix <fixer> --dry-run")
    52→    return [
    53→        {
    54→            "type": "auto_fixers_available",
    55→            "message": f"{total} findings are auto-fixable. Run `{first_cmd}`.",
    56→            "command": first_cmd,
    57→        }
    58→    ]
    59→
    60→
    61→def _rescan_needed_reminder(command: str | None) -> list[dict]:
    62→    if command not in {"fix", "resolve", "ignore"}:
    63→        return []
    64→    return [
    65→        {
    66→            "type": "rescan_needed",
    67→            "message": "Rescan to verify — cascading effects may create new findings.",
    68→            "command": "desloppify scan",
    69→        }
    70→    ]
    71→
    72→
    73→def _badge_reminder(strict_score: float | None, badge: dict) -> list[dict]:
    74→    eligible_for_badge = (
    75→        strict_score is not None
    76→        and strict_score >= 90
    77→        and badge.get("generated")
    78→        and not badge.get("in_readme")
    79→    )
    80→    if not eligible_for_badge:
    81→        return []
    82→    badge_path = str(badge.get("path") or "scorecard.png")
    83→    return [
    84→        {
    85→            "type": "badge_recommendation",
    86→            "message": (
    87→                "Score is above 90! Add the scorecard to your README: "
    88→                f'<img src="{badge_path}" width="100%">'
    89→            ),
    90→            "command": None,
    91→        }
    92→    ]
    93→
    94→
    95→def _wontfix_debt_reminders(state: StateModel, debt: dict, command: str | None) -> list[dict]:
    96→    reminders: list[dict] = []
    97→    if debt.get("trend") == "growing":
    98→        reminders.append(
    99→            {
   100→                "type": "wontfix_growing",
   101→                "message": "Wontfix debt is growing. Review stale decisions: `desloppify show --status wontfix`.",
   102→                "command": "desloppify show --status wontfix",
   103→            }
   104→        )
   105→
   106→    scan_count = len(state.get("scan_history", []))
   107→    if scan_count < 20 or command != "scan":
   108→        return reminders
   109→
   110→    stale_wontfix = []
   111→    for finding in state.get("findings", {}).values():
   112→        if finding.get("status") != "wontfix":
   113→            continue
   114→        resolved_at = finding.get("resolved_at")
   115→        if not resolved_at:
   116→            continue
   117→        try:
   118→            age_days = (_dt.now(UTC) - _dt.fromisoformat(resolved_at)).days
   119→        except (ValueError, TypeError) as exc:
   120→            log_best_effort_failure(
   121→                logger, f"parse wontfix timestamp {resolved_at!r}", exc
   122→            )
   123→            continue
   124→        if age_days > 60:
   125→            stale_wontfix.append(finding)
   126→
   127→    if stale_wontfix:
   128→        reminders.append(
   129→            {
   130→                "type": "wontfix_stale",
   131→                "message": (
   132→                    f"{len(stale_wontfix)} wontfix item(s) are >60 days old. "
   133→                    f"Has anything changed? Review with: "
   134→                    f'`desloppify show "*" --status wontfix`'
   135→                ),
   136→                "command": 'desloppify show "*" --status wontfix',
   137→            }
   138→        )
   139→    return reminders
   140→
   141→
   142→def _ignore_suppression_reminder(state: StateModel) -> list[dict]:
   143→    """Nudge when ignores/suppression are high enough to mask signal quality."""
   144→    integrity = state.get("ignore_integrity", {}) or {}
   145→    ignored = int(integrity.get("ignored", 0) or 0)
   146→    suppressed_pct = float(integrity.get("suppressed_pct", 0.0) or 0.0)
   147→    if ignored < 10 and suppressed_pct < 30.0:
   148→        return []
   149→    return [
   150→        {
   151→            "type": "ignore_suppression_high",
   152→            "message": (
   153→                f"Ignore suppression is high ({ignored} ignored, {suppressed_pct:.1f}% suppressed). "
   154→                "Revisit broad ignore patterns and resolve stale suppressions."
   155→            ),
   156→            "command": "desloppify show --status wontfix",
   157→        }
   158→    ]
   159→
   160→
   161→def _stagnation_reminders(dimensions: dict) -> list[dict]:
   162→    reminders: list[dict] = []
   163→    for dim in dimensions.get("stagnant_dimensions", []):
   164→        strict = dim.get("strict", 0)
   165→        if strict >= 99:
   166→            message = (
   167→                f"{dim['name']} has been at {strict}% for {dim['stuck_scans']} scans. "
   168→                f"The remaining items may be worth marking as wontfix if they're intentional."
   169→            )
   170→        else:
   171→            message = (
   172→                f"{dim['name']} has been stuck at {strict}% for {dim['stuck_scans']} scans. "
   173→                f"Try tackling it from a different angle — run `desloppify next` to find the right entry point."
   174→            )
   175→        reminders.append(
   176→            {
   177→                "type": "stagnant_nudge",
   178→                "message": message,
   179→                "command": None,
   180→            }
   181→        )
   182→    return reminders
   183→
   184→
   185→def _dry_run_reminder(actions: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
   186→    if not actions or actions[0].get("type") != "auto_fix":
   187→        return []
   188→    return [
   189→        {
   190→            "type": "dry_run_first",
   191→            "message": "Always --dry-run first, review changes, then apply.",
   192→            "command": None,
   193→        }
   194→    ]
   195→
   196→
   197→def _zone_classification_reminder(state: StateModel) -> list[dict]:
   198→    zone_dist = state.get("zone_distribution")
   199→    if not zone_dist:
   200→        return []
   201→    non_prod = sum(value for key, value in zone_dist.items() if key != "production")
   202→    if non_prod <= 0:
   203→        return []
   204→    total = sum(zone_dist.values())
   205→    parts = [
   206→        f"{value} {key}"
   207→        for key, value in sorted(zone_dist.items())
   208→        if key != "production" and value > 0
   209→    ]
   210→    return [
   211→        {
   212→            "type": "zone_classification",
   213→            "message": (
   214→                f"{non_prod} of {total} files classified as non-production "
   215→                f"({', '.join(parts)}). "
   216→                f"Override with `desloppify zone set <file> production` "
   217→                f"if any are misclassified."
   218→            ),
   219→            "command": "desloppify zone show",
   220→        }
   221→    ]
   222→
   223→
   224→def _fp_calibration_reminders(fp_rates: dict[tuple[str, str], float]) -> list[dict]:
   225→    reminders: list[dict] = []
   226→    for (detector, zone), rate in fp_rates.items():
   227→        if rate <= 0.3:
   228→            continue
   229→        pct = round(rate * 100)
   230→        reminders.append(
   231→            {
   232→                "type": f"fp_calibration_{detector}_{zone}",
   233→                "message": (
   234→                    f"{pct}% of {detector} findings in {zone} zone are false positives. "
   235→                    f"Consider reviewing detection rules for {zone} files."
   236→                ),
   237→                "command": None,
   238→            }
   239→        )
   240→    return reminders
   241→
   242→
   243→def _review_queue_reminders(
   244→    state: StateModel,
   245→    scoped_findings: dict,
   246→    command: str | None,
   247→    strict_score: float | None,
   248→) -> list[dict]:
   249→    reminders: list[dict] = []
   250→    open_review = [
   251→        finding
   252→        for finding in scoped_findings.values()
   253→        if finding.get("status") == "open" and finding.get("detector") == "review"
   254→    ]
   255→    if open_review:
   256→        uninvestigated = [
   257→            finding
   258→            for finding in open_review
   259→            if not finding.get("detail", {}).get("investigation")
   260→        ]
   261→        if uninvestigated:
   262→            reminders.append(
   263→                {
   264→                    "type": "review_findings_pending",
   265→                    "message": f"{len(uninvestigated)} review finding(s) need investigation. "
   266→                    f"Run `desloppify show review --status open` to see the work queue.",
   267→                    "command": "desloppify show review --status open",
   268→                }
   269→            )
   270→
   271→    _sa = state.get("subjective_assessments") or {}
   272→    _has_real_assessments = any(
   273→        isinstance(v, dict) and not v.get("placeholder")
   274→        for v in _sa.values()
   275→    )
   276→    if command == "resolve" and _has_real_assessments:
   277→        reminders.append(
   278→            {
   279→                "type": "rereview_needed",
   280→                "message": "Subjective results may be stale after resolve. Re-run "
   281→                "`desloppify review --prepare` to refresh, or reset with "
   282→                "`desloppify scan --reset-subjective` before a clean rerun.",
   283→                "command": "desloppify review --prepare",
   284→            }
   285→        )
   286→
   287→    review_cache = state.get("review_cache", {})
   288→    if not review_cache.get("files"):
   289→        current_strict = strict_score or 0
   290→        if current_strict >= 80:
   291→            reminders.append(
   292→                {
   293→                    "type": "review_not_run",
   294→                    "message": (
   295→                        "Mechanical checks look good! Run a subjective design review "
   296→                        "to catch issues linters miss: desloppify review --prepare"
   297→                    ),
   298→                    "command": "desloppify review --prepare",
   299→                }
   300→            )
   301→
   302→    return reminders
   303→
   304→
   305→def _has_open_findings(state: StateModel) -> bool:
   306→    """True when any non-suppressed open findings remain in the queue."""
   307→    return any(
   308→        f.get("status") == "open" and not f.get("suppressed")
   309→        for f in (state.get("findings") or {}).values()
   310→    )
   311→
   312→
   313→def _stale_assessment_reminder(state: StateModel) -> list[dict]:
   314→    """Nudge when mechanical changes have staled subjective assessments."""
   315→    if _has_open_findings(state):
   316→        return []
   317→    assessments = state.get("subjective_assessments") or {}
   318→    stale_dims = [
   319→        dim_key
   320→        for dim_key, assessment in assessments.items()
   321→        if isinstance(assessment, dict) and assessment.get("needs_review_refresh")
   322→    ]
   323→    if not stale_dims:
   324→        return []
   325→    dims_arg = ",".join(stale_dims[:10])
   326→    return [
   327→        {
   328→            "type": "stale_assessments",
   329→            "message": (
   330→                f"{len(stale_dims)} subjective dimension{'s' if len(stale_dims) != 1 else ''} "
   331→                f"stale after mechanical changes — re-review with: "
   332→                f"`desloppify review --prepare --dimensions {dims_arg}`"
   333→            ),
   334→            "command": f"desloppify review --prepare --dimensions {dims_arg}",
   335→        }
   336→    ]
   337→
   338→
   339→def _review_staleness_reminder(state: StateModel, config: dict | None) -> list[dict]:
   340→    review_max_age = (config or {}).get("review_max_age_days", 30)
   341→    review_cache = state.get("review_cache", {})
   342→    if review_max_age <= 0 or not review_cache.get("files"):
   343→        return []
   344→    try:
   345→        oldest_str = min(
   346→            review["reviewed_at"]
   347→            for review in review_cache["files"].values()
   348→            if review.get("reviewed_at")
   349→        )
   350→        oldest = _dt.fromisoformat(oldest_str)
   351→        age_days = (_dt.now(UTC) - oldest).days
   352→    except (ValueError, TypeError) as exc:
   353→        log_best_effort_failure(logger, "parse oldest review timestamp", exc)
   354→        return []
   355→    if age_days <= review_max_age:
   356→        return []
   357→    return [
   358→        {
   359→            "type": "review_stale",
   360→            "message": f"Design review is {age_days} days old — run: desloppify review --prepare",
   361→            "command": "desloppify review --prepare",
   362→        }
   363→    ]
   364→
   365→
   366→def _feedback_reminder(
   367→    state: StateModel,
   368→    phase: str,
   369→    command: str | None,
   370→    fp_rates: dict[tuple[str, str], float],
   371→) -> list[dict]:
   372→    scan_count = len(state.get("scan_history", []))
   373→    if scan_count < 2 or command != "scan":
   374→        return []
   375→    high_fp_dets = [
   376→        detector for (detector, _zone), rate in fp_rates.items() if rate > 0.3
   377→    ]
   378→    if high_fp_dets:
   379→        nudge_msg = (
   380→            f"Some detectors have high false-positive rates ({', '.join(high_fp_dets)}). "
   381→            f"If patterns are being misclassified, file an issue at "
   382→            f"{_FEEDBACK_URL} with the file and expected behavior — "
   383→            f"it helps calibrate detection for everyone."
   384→        )
   385→    elif phase == "stagnation":
   386→        nudge_msg = (
   387→            f"Score has plateaued — if you suspect desloppify is missing patterns "
   388→            f"or not capturing something it should, file an issue at "
   389→            f"{_FEEDBACK_URL} describing what you expected. "
   390→            f"Gaps in detection are a common cause of stagnation."
   391→        )
   392→    else:
   393→        nudge_msg = (
   394→            f"If you notice patterns desloppify doesn't detect, false positives, "
   395→            f"or findings that seem off, file an issue at {_FEEDBACK_URL} — "
   396→            f"include the file and what you expected. It helps improve the tool."
   397→        )
   398→    return [
   399→        {
   400→            "type": "feedback_nudge",
   401→            "message": nudge_msg,
   402→            "command": None,
   403→        }
   404→    ]
   405→
   406→
   407→_REMINDER_METADATA: dict[str, tuple[int, str]] = {
   408→    # Highest urgency operational nudges.
   409→    "rescan_needed": (1, "high"),
   410→    "ignore_suppression_high": (1, "high"),
   411→    "review_findings_pending": (1, "high"),
   412→    "rereview_needed": (1, "high"),
   413→    # Medium urgency quality/process nudges.
   414→    "wontfix_growing": (2, "medium"),
   415→    "wontfix_stale": (2, "medium"),
   416→    "stagnant_nudge": (2, "medium"),
   417→    "review_stale": (2, "medium"),
   418→    "stale_assessments": (2, "medium"),
   419→    "auto_fixers_available": (2, "medium"),
   420→    "zone_classification": (2, "medium"),
   421→    "fp_calibration": (2, "medium"),
   422→    # Informational nudges.
   423→    "badge_recommendation": (3, "low"),
   424→    "dry_run_first": (3, "low"),
   425→    "feedback_nudge": (3, "low"),
   426→    "review_not_run": (3, "low"),
   427→    "report_scores": (3, "low"),
   428→}
   429→
   430→
   431→def _decorate_reminder_metadata(reminders: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
   432→    """Attach stable priority/severity metadata and sort by priority."""
   433→    decorated: list[dict] = []
   434→    for reminder in reminders:
   435→        reminder_type = str(reminder.get("type", ""))
   436→        key = reminder_type
   437→        if reminder_type.startswith("fp_calibration_"):
   438→            key = "fp_calibration"
   439→        priority, severity = _REMINDER_METADATA.get(key, (3, "low"))
   440→        clone = dict(reminder)
   441→        clone.setdefault("priority", priority)
   442→        clone.setdefault("severity", severity)
   443→        decorated.append(clone)
   444→    decorated.sort(key=lambda item: (int(item.get("priority", 3)), str(item.get("type", ""))))
   445→    return decorated
   446→
   447→
   448→def _report_scores_reminder(command: str | None) -> list[dict]:
   449→    if command != "scan":
   450→        return []
   451→    return [
   452→        {
   453→            "type": "report_scores",
   454→            "message": (
   455→                "ALWAYS share ALL scores with the user: overall, objective, and strict, "
   456→                "plus every dimension score (lenient + strict), including subjective dimensions. "
   457→                "The goal is to maximize strict scores."
   458→            ),
   459→            "command": None,
   460→            "no_decay": True,
   461→        }
   462→    ]
   463→
   464→
   465→def _apply_decay(
   466→    reminders: list[dict], reminder_history: dict
   467→) -> tuple[list[dict], dict]:
   468→    filtered: list[dict] = []
   469→    for reminder in reminders:
   470→        if reminder.get("no_decay"):
   471→            filtered.append(reminder)
   472→            continue
   473→        count = reminder_history.get(reminder["type"], 0)
   474→        if count < _REMINDER_DECAY_THRESHOLD:
   475→            filtered.append(reminder)
   476→
   477→    updated_history = dict(reminder_history)
   478→    for reminder in filtered:
   479→        updated_history[reminder["type"]] = updated_history.get(reminder["type"], 0) + 1
   480→    return filtered, updated_history
   481→
   482→
   483→def _compute_reminders(
   484→    state: StateModel,
   485→    lang: str | None,
   486→    phase: str,
   487→    debt: dict,
   488→    actions: list[dict],
   489→    dimensions: dict,
   490→    badge: dict,
   491→    command: str | None,
   492→    config: dict | None = None,
   493→) -> tuple[list[dict], dict]:
   494→    """Compute context-specific reminders, suppressing those shown too many times."""
   495→    del lang  # Reserved for future language-specific rules.
   496→
   497→    strict_score = get_strict_score(state)
   498→    reminder_history = state.get("reminder_history", {})
   499→    scoped_findings = path_scoped_findings(
   500→        state.get("findings", {}), state.get("scan_path")
   501→    )
   502→    fp_rates = _compute_fp_rates(scoped_findings)
   503→
   504→    reminders: list[dict] = []
   505→    reminders.extend(_report_scores_reminder(command))
   506→    reminders.extend(_auto_fixer_reminder(actions))
   507→    reminders.extend(_rescan_needed_reminder(command))
   508→    reminders.extend(_badge_reminder(strict_score, badge))
   509→    reminders.extend(_wontfix_debt_reminders(state, debt, command))
   510→    reminders.extend(_ignore_suppression_reminder(state))
   511→    reminders.extend(_stagnation_reminders(dimensions))
   512→    reminders.extend(_dry_run_reminder(actions))
   513→    reminders.extend(_zone_classification_reminder(state))
   514→    reminders.extend(_fp_calibration_reminders(fp_rates))
   515→    reminders.extend(
   516→        _review_queue_reminders(state, scoped_findings, command, strict_score)
   517→    )
   518→    reminders.extend(_stale_assessment_reminder(state))
   519→    reminders.extend(_review_staleness_reminder(state, config))
   520→    reminders.extend(_feedback_reminder(state, phase, command, fp_rates))
   521→
   522→    reminders = _decorate_reminder_metadata(reminders)
   523→    return _apply_decay(reminders, reminder_history)
   524→

    96→# Detectors where potential = file count but findings are per-(file, sub-type).
    97→# Per-file weighted failures are capped at 1.0 to match the file-based denominator.
    98→FILE_BASED_DETECTORS = {
    99→    detector
   100→    for detector, policy in DETECTOR_SCORING_POLICIES.items()
   101→    if policy.file_based

   104→
   105→def _build_dimensions() -> list[Dimension]:
   106→    """Derive dimensions from DETECTOR_SCORING_POLICIES.
   107→
   108→    Each unique (dimension, tier) pair becomes a Dimension, with its detectors
   109→    collected automatically. Order follows first-seen in the policies dict.
   110→    """
   111→    # Collect (dimension_name -> tier) preserving first-seen order,
   112→    # and group detectors by dimension.
   113→    dim_tiers: dict[str, int] = {}
   114→    grouped: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
   115→    for detector, policy in DETECTOR_SCORING_POLICIES.items():
   116→        if policy.dimension is None or policy.tier is None:
   117→            continue
   118→        if policy.dimension not in dim_tiers:
   119→            dim_tiers[policy.dimension] = policy.tier
   120→            grouped[policy.dimension] = []
   121→        grouped[policy.dimension].append(detector)
   122→    return [
   123→        Dimension(name=name, tier=tier, detectors=grouped[name])
   124→        for name, tier in dim_tiers.items()
   125→    ]
   126→
   127→
   128→DIMENSIONS = _build_dimensions()
   129→DIMENSIONS_BY_NAME = {d.name: d for d in DIMENSIONS}
   130→
   131→TIER_WEIGHTS = {
   132→    Tier.AUTO_FIX: 1,
   133→    Tier.QUICK_FIX: 2,
   134→    Tier.JUDGMENT: 3,
   135→    Tier.MAJOR_REFACTOR: 4,
   136→}
   137→# Re-exported from core.scoring_constants:
   138→# CONFIDENCE_WEIGHTS, HOLISTIC_MULTIPLIER
   139→
   140→# Minimum checks for full dimension weight — below this, weight is dampened
   141→# proportionally. Prevents small-sample dimensions from swinging the overall score.
   142→MIN_SAMPLE = 200
   143→
   144→HOLISTIC_POTENTIAL = 10
   145→
   146→# Budget: subjective dimensions get this fraction of the overall score.
   147→# Mechanical dimensions get the remainder.
   148→SUBJECTIVE_WEIGHT_FRACTION = 0.60
   149→MECHANICAL_WEIGHT_FRACTION = 1.0 - SUBJECTIVE_WEIGHT_FRACTION
   150→
   151→# Per-dimension weighting within the mechanical pool.
   152→# Keep this balanced: no special boost for security/test in the pool itself.
   153→MECHANICAL_DIMENSION_WEIGHTS: dict[str, float] = {
   154→    "file health": 2.0,
   155→    "code quality": 1.0,
   156→    "duplication": 1.0,
   157→    "test health": 1.0,
   158→    "security": 1.0,
   159→}
   160→
   161→# Per-dimension weighting within the subjective pool.
   162→# Emphasize elegance and contract/type coherence for a stronger architecture north star.
   163→SUBJECTIVE_DIMENSION_WEIGHTS: dict[str, float] = {
   164→    "high elegance": 22.0,
   165→    "mid elegance": 22.0,
   166→    "low elegance": 12.0,
   167→    "contracts": 12.0,
   168→    "type safety": 12.0,
   169→    "abstraction fit": 8.0,
   170→    "logic clarity": 6.0,
   171→    # Low-but-meaningful structural signal (about half of the subjective
   172→    # average weight) so it matters without dominating craftsmanship axes.
   173→    "structure nav": 5.0,
   174→    "error consistency": 3.0,
   175→    "naming quality": 2.0,
   176→    "ai generated debt": 1.0,
   177→    "design coherence": 10.0,
   178→}
   179→
   180→# Synthetic check count for subjective dimensions in dimension_scores.
   181→SUBJECTIVE_CHECKS = 10
   182→
   183→FAILURE_STATUSES_BY_MODE: dict[ScoreMode, frozenset[str]] = {
   184→    "lenient": frozenset({"open"}),
   185→    "strict": frozenset({"open", "wontfix"}),
   186→    "verified_strict": frozenset({"open", "wontfix", "fixed", "false_positive"}),
   187→}
   188→
   189→# Tolerance for treating a subjective score as "on target" in integrity checks.
   190→# Scores within this band of the target are flagged as potential gaming.
   191→SUBJECTIVE_TARGET_MATCH_TOLERANCE = 0.05
   192→
   193→
   194→def matches_target_score(
   195→    score: object,
   196→    target: object,
   197→    *,
   198→    tolerance: float = SUBJECTIVE_TARGET_MATCH_TOLERANCE,
   199→) -> bool:
   200→    """Return True when score is within tolerance of target."""
   201→    try:
   202→        score_value = float(score)
   203→        target_value = float(target)
   204→        tolerance_value = max(0.0, float(tolerance))
   205→    except (TypeError, ValueError):
   206→        return False
   207→    return abs(score_value - target_value) <= tolerance_value
   208→
   209→
   210→def register_scoring_policy(policy: DetectorScoringPolicy) -> None:
   211→    """Register a scoring policy at runtime (used by generic plugins)."""
   212→    DETECTOR_SCORING_POLICIES[policy.detector] = policy
   213→    _rebuild_derived()
   214→
   215→
   216→def _rebuild_derived() -> None:
   217→    """Rebuild DIMENSIONS, DIMENSIONS_BY_NAME, FILE_BASED_DETECTORS from current state.
   218→
   219→    Mutates existing objects in-place so that all references (including imports
   220→    that bound the original objects) see the updates.
   221→    """
   222→    new_dims = _build_dimensions()
   223→    DIMENSIONS.clear()
   224→    DIMENSIONS.extend(new_dims)
   225→    DIMENSIONS_BY_NAME.clear()
   226→    DIMENSIONS_BY_NAME.update({d.name: d for d in DIMENSIONS})
   227→    FILE_BASED_DETECTORS.clear()
   228→    FILE_BASED_DETECTORS.update(
   229→        det for det, pol in DETECTOR_SCORING_POLICIES.items() if pol.file_based
   230→    )
   231→
   232→
   233→def detector_policy(detector: str) -> DetectorScoringPolicy:
   234→    """Get scoring policy for a detector, with a safe default fallback."""
   235→    return DETECTOR_SCORING_POLICIES.get(
   236→        detector,
   237→        DetectorScoringPolicy(detector=detector, dimension=None, tier=None),
   238→    )
   239→

   242→    "CONFIDENCE_WEIGHTS",

    58→def _apply_plan_order(
    59→    items: list[dict],
    60→    plan: dict,
    61→    *,
    62→    include_skipped: bool = False,
    63→    cluster: str | None = None,
    64→) -> list[dict]:
    65→    """Reorder items according to the living plan.
    66→
    67→    1. Items in ``queue_order`` appear first, in that order.
    68→    2. Remaining items keep their mechanical sort.
    69→    3. Skipped items are appended last (or excluded).
    70→    4. Each item is annotated with plan metadata.
    71→    """
    72→    queue_order: list[str] = plan.get("queue_order", [])
    73→    skipped_map: dict = plan.get("skipped", {})
    74→    skipped_ids: set[str] = set(skipped_map.keys())
    75→    overrides: dict = plan.get("overrides", {})
    76→    clusters: dict = plan.get("clusters", {})
    77→    active_cluster = plan.get("active_cluster")
    78→
    79→    # Build lookup
    80→    by_id: dict[str, dict] = {}
    81→    for item in items:
    82→        by_id[item["id"]] = item
    83→
    84→    # Annotate items with plan metadata
    85→    for item_id, item in by_id.items():
    86→        override = overrides.get(item_id, {})
    87→        if override.get("description"):
    88→            item["plan_description"] = override["description"]
    89→        if override.get("note"):
    90→            item["plan_note"] = override["note"]
    91→        if override.get("cluster"):
    92→            cluster_name = override["cluster"]
    93→            cluster_data = clusters.get(cluster_name, {})
    94→            item["plan_cluster"] = {
    95→                "name": cluster_name,
    96→                "description": cluster_data.get("description"),
    97→                "total_items": len(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", [])),
    98→                "sibling_ids": cluster_data.get("finding_ids", []),
    99→            }
   100→
   101→    # Split into ordered, remaining, skipped
   102→    ordered: list[dict] = []
   103→    ordered_ids: set[str] = set()
   104→    for fid in queue_order:
   105→        if fid in by_id and fid not in skipped_ids:
   106→            ordered.append(by_id[fid])
   107→            ordered_ids.add(fid)
   108→
   109→    skipped_items: list[dict] = []
   110→    remaining: list[dict] = []
   111→    for item in items:
   112→        item_id = item["id"]
   113→        if item_id in ordered_ids:
   114→            continue
   115→        if item_id in skipped_ids:
   116→            skipped_items.append(item)
   117→        else:
   118→            remaining.append(item)
   119→
   120→    # Assign queue positions
   121→    result = ordered + remaining
   122→    if include_skipped:
   123→        result = result + skipped_items
   124→
   125→    for pos, item in enumerate(result):
   126→        item["queue_position"] = pos + 1
   127→        if item["id"] in skipped_ids:
   128→            item["plan_skipped"] = True
   129→            skip_entry = skipped_map.get(item["id"])
   130→            if skip_entry:
   131→                item["plan_skip_kind"] = skip_entry.get("kind", "temporary")
   132→                skip_reason = skip_entry.get("reason")
   133→                if skip_reason:
   134→                    item["plan_skip_reason"] = skip_reason
   135→
   136→    # Filter to cluster if requested
   137→    effective_cluster = cluster or active_cluster
   138→    if effective_cluster:
   139→        cluster_data = clusters.get(effective_cluster, {})
   140→        cluster_member_ids = set(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", []))
   141→        if cluster_member_ids:
   142→            result = [item for item in result if item["id"] in cluster_member_ids]
   143→
   144→    return result

   147→def _item_matches_tier(item: dict, tier: int) -> bool:
   148→    """Check if an item (or any of its members for clusters) matches a tier."""
   149→    if item.get("kind") == "cluster":
   150→        return any(
   151→            int(m.get("effective_tier", m.get("tier", 3))) == tier
   152→            for m in item.get("members", [])
   153→        )
   154→    return int(item.get("effective_tier", item.get("tier", 3))) == tier

   157→def _action_type_for_detector(detector: str) -> str:
   158→    """Look up the action_type for a detector from the registry."""
   159→    try:
   160→        from desloppify.base.registry import DETECTORS
   161→        meta = DETECTORS.get(detector)
   162→        if meta:
   163→            return meta.action_type
   164→    except ImportError:
   165→        pass
   166→    return "manual_fix"

   168→
   169→_ACTION_TYPE_PRIORITY = {"auto_fix": 0, "reorganize": 1, "refactor": 2, "manual_fix": 3}

   172→def _collapse_clusters(items: list[dict], plan: dict) -> list[dict]:
   173→    """Replace cluster member items with single cluster meta-items."""
   174→    clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
   175→    if not clusters:
   176→        return items
   177→
   178→    # Build mapping: finding_id → auto-cluster name
   179→    fid_to_cluster: dict[str, str] = {}
   180→    for name, cluster in clusters.items():
   181→        if not cluster.get("auto"):
   182→            continue
   183→        for fid in cluster.get("finding_ids", []):
   184→            fid_to_cluster[fid] = name
   185→
   186→    if not fid_to_cluster:
   187→        return items
   188→
   189→    # Collect members for each cluster, preserving order
   190→    cluster_members: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
   191→    non_cluster_items: list[dict] = []
   192→
   193→    for item in items:
   194→        cname = fid_to_cluster.get(item.get("id", ""))
   195→        if cname:
   196→            cluster_members.setdefault(cname, []).append(item)
   197→        else:
   198→            non_cluster_items.append(item)
   199→
   200→    # Build cluster meta-items
   201→    result: list[dict] = list(non_cluster_items)
   202→    for cname, members in cluster_members.items():
   203→        # Don't collapse singletons — show them as individual findings
   204→        if len(members) < 2:
   205→            result.extend(members)
   206→            continue
   207→        cluster_data = clusters.get(cname, {})
   208→        detector = members[0].get("detector", "") if members else ""
   209→        action = cluster_data.get("action") or ""
   210→        # Derive action_type from the actual cluster action, not just the detector
   211→        if cname in ("auto/initial-review", "auto/stale-review"):
   212→            action_type = "initial_review"
   213→        elif "desloppify fix" in action:
   214→            action_type = "auto_fix"
   215→        elif "desloppify move" in action:
   216→            action_type = "reorganize"
   217→        else:
   218→            action_type = _action_type_for_detector(detector)
   219→            # If detector says auto_fix but cluster has no fix command, it's really refactor
   220→            if action_type == "auto_fix" and "desloppify fix" not in action:
   221→                action_type = "refactor"
   222→
   223→        # Use stored description but patch the count if it differs from visible members
   224→        stored_desc = cluster_data.get("description") or ""
   225→        total_in_cluster = len(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", []))
   226→        if stored_desc and total_in_cluster != len(members):
   227→            # Replace the stored count with the visible count
   228→            summary = stored_desc.replace(str(total_in_cluster), str(len(members)))
   229→        else:
   230→            summary = stored_desc or f"{len(members)} findings"
   231→
   232→        primary_command = cluster_data.get("action")
   233→        if not primary_command:
   234→            primary_command = f"desloppify next --cluster {cname} --count 10"
   235→
   236→        meta_item: dict = {
   237→            "id": cname,
   238→            "kind": "cluster",
   239→            "action_type": action_type,
   240→            "summary": summary,
   241→            "members": members,
   242→            "member_count": len(members),
   243→            "primary_command": primary_command,
   244→            "cluster_name": cname,
   245→            "cluster_auto": True,
   246→            "confidence": "high",
   247→            "detector": detector,
   248→            "file": "",
   249→        }
   250→        result.append(meta_item)
   251→
   252→    result.sort(key=item_sort_key)
   253→    return result

   256→def build_work_queue(
   257→    state: StateModel,
   258→    *,
   259→    options: QueueBuildOptions | None = None,
   260→) -> WorkQueueResult:
   261→    """Build ranked queue items + tier metadata."""
   262→    resolved_options = options or QueueBuildOptions()
   263→
   264→    status = resolved_options.status
   265→    if status not in ALL_STATUSES:
   266→        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported status filter: {status}")
   267→    try:
   268→        subjective_threshold_value = float(resolved_options.subjective_threshold)
   269→    except (TypeError, ValueError):
   270→        subjective_threshold_value = 100.0
   271→    subjective_threshold_value = max(0.0, min(100.0, subjective_threshold_value))
   272→
   273→    finding_items = build_finding_items(
   274→        state,
   275→        scan_path=resolved_options.scan_path,
   276→        status_filter=status,
   277→        scope=resolved_options.scope,
   278→        chronic=resolved_options.chronic,
   279→    )
   280→
   281→    all_items = list(finding_items)
   282→    if (
   283→        resolved_options.include_subjective
   284→        and status in {"open", "all"}
   285→        and not resolved_options.chronic
   286→    ):
   287→        subjective_items = build_subjective_items(
   288→            state,
   289→            state.get("findings", {}),
   290→            threshold=subjective_threshold_value,
   291→        )
   292→        for item in subjective_items:
   293→            if scope_matches(item, resolved_options.scope):
   294→                all_items.append(item)
   295→
   296→    all_items.sort(key=item_sort_key)
   297→
   298→    # Apply living plan ordering if provided
   299→    if resolved_options.plan:
   300→        all_items = _apply_plan_order(
   301→            all_items,
   302→            resolved_options.plan,
   303→            include_skipped=resolved_options.include_skipped,
   304→            cluster=resolved_options.cluster,
   305→        )
   306→
   307→    # Collapse auto-clusters into meta-items (unless drilling into a cluster)
   308→    should_collapse = (
   309→        resolved_options.collapse_clusters
   310→        and resolved_options.plan
   311→        and not resolved_options.cluster
   312→        and not resolved_options.plan.get("active_cluster")
   313→    )
   314→    if should_collapse:
   315→        all_items = _collapse_clusters(all_items, resolved_options.plan)
   316→
   317→    counts = tier_counts(all_items)
   318→
   319→    requested_tier = (
   320→        int(resolved_options.tier) if resolved_options.tier is not None else None
   321→    )
   322→    selected_tier = requested_tier
   323→    fallback_reason = None
   324→    filtered = all_items
   325→
   326→    if requested_tier is not None:
   327→        filtered = [
   328→            item
   329→            for item in all_items
   330→            if _item_matches_tier(item, requested_tier)
   331→        ]
   332→        if not filtered and not resolved_options.no_tier_fallback:
   333→            chosen = choose_fallback_tier(requested_tier, counts)
   334→            if chosen is not None:
   335→                selected_tier = chosen
   336→                filtered = [
   337→                    item
   338→                    for item in all_items
   339→                    if _item_matches_tier(item, chosen)
   340→                ]
   341→                fallback_reason = (
   342→                    f"Requested T{requested_tier} has 0 open -> showing T{chosen} "
   343→                    "(nearest non-empty)."
   344→                )
   345→        elif not filtered:
   346→            fallback_reason = f"Requested T{requested_tier} has 0 open."
   347→
   348→    total = len(filtered)
   349→    if resolved_options.count is not None and resolved_options.count > 0:
   350→        filtered = filtered[: resolved_options.count]
   351→
   352→    if resolved_options.explain:
   353→        for item in filtered:
   354→            item["explain"] = item_explain(item)
   355→
   356→    available_tiers = [tier for tier, value in counts.items() if value > 0]
   357→    return {
   358→        "items": filtered,

1→"""Ranking and grouping helpers for work queue selection."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→from desloppify.engine._work_queue.helpers import (
     6→    detail_dict,

    18→from desloppify.state import path_scoped_findings
    19→
    20→
    21→def subjective_score_value(item: dict) -> float:
    22→    if item.get("kind") == "subjective_dimension":
    23→        detail = detail_dict(item)
    24→        return float(detail.get("strict_score", item.get("subjective_score", 100.0)))
    25→    return float(item.get("subjective_score", 100.0))
    26→
    27→
    28→def build_finding_items(
    29→    state: dict,
    30→    *,
    31→    scan_path: str | None,
    32→    status_filter: str,
    33→    scope: str | None,
    34→    chronic: bool,
    35→) -> list[dict]:
    36→    scoped = path_scoped_findings(state.get("findings", {}), scan_path)
    37→    subjective_scores = subjective_strict_scores(state)
    38→    out: list[dict] = []
    39→
    40→    for finding_id, finding in scoped.items():
    41→        if finding.get("suppressed"):
    42→            continue
    43→        if not status_matches(finding.get("status", "open"), status_filter):
    44→            continue
    45→        if chronic and not (
    46→            finding.get("status") == "open" and finding.get("reopen_count", 0) >= 2
    47→        ):
    48→            continue
    49→
    50→        item = dict(finding)
    51→        item["id"] = finding_id
    52→        item["kind"] = "finding"
    53→        item["is_review"] = is_review_finding(item)
    54→        item["is_subjective"] = is_subjective_finding(item)
    55→        item["effective_tier"] = (
    56→            4 if item["is_subjective"] else int(finding.get("tier", 3))
    57→        )
    58→        item["review_weight"] = (
    59→            review_finding_weight(item) if item["is_review"] else None
    60→        )
    61→        subjective_score = None
    62→        if item["is_subjective"]:
    63→            detail = detail_dict(finding)
    64→            dim_name = detail.get("dimension_name", "")
    65→            dim_key = detail.get("dimension", "") or slugify(dim_name)
    66→            subjective_score = subjective_scores.get(
    67→                dim_key, subjective_scores.get(dim_name.lower(), 100.0)
    68→            )
    69→        item["subjective_score"] = subjective_score
    70→        supported_fixers = supported_fixers_for_item(state, item)
    71→        item["primary_command"] = primary_command_for_finding(
    72→            item,
    73→            supported_fixers=supported_fixers,
    74→        )
    75→
    76→        if not scope_matches(item, scope):
    77→            continue
    78→        out.append(item)
    79→
    80→    return out
    81→
    82→
    83→_CLUSTER_ACTION_PRIORITY = {
    84→    "initial_review": -1,
    85→    "auto_fix": 0,
    86→    "reorganize": 1,
    87→    "refactor": 2,
    88→    "manual_fix": 3,
    89→}
    90→
    91→
    92→def item_sort_key(item: dict) -> tuple:
    93→    if item.get("kind") == "cluster":
    94→        # Clusters sort before individual findings, ordered by action type
    95→        # (auto_fix first, then reorganize, refactor, manual_fix),
    96→        # then bigger clusters first within the same action type.
    97→        action_pri = _CLUSTER_ACTION_PRIORITY.get(
    98→            item.get("action_type", "manual_fix"), 3
    99→        )
   100→        return (
   101→            0,  # All clusters before all individual findings
   102→            action_pri,
   103→            -int(item.get("member_count", 0)),
   104→            item.get("id", ""),
   105→        )
   106→
   107→    if item.get("kind") == "subjective_dimension" or item.get("is_subjective"):
   108→        return (
   109→            int(item.get("effective_tier", 4)),
   110→            1,  # Subjective items sort after mechanical items within T4.
   111→            subjective_score_value(item),
   112→            item.get("id", ""),
   113→        )
   114→
   115→    detail = detail_dict(item)
   116→    review_weight = float(item.get("review_weight", 0.0) or 0.0)
   117→    return (
   118→        int(item.get("effective_tier", item.get("tier", 3))),
   119→        0,
   120→        CONFIDENCE_ORDER.get(item.get("confidence", "low"), 9),
   121→        -review_weight,
   122→        -int(detail.get("count", 0) or 0),
   123→        item.get("id", ""),
   124→    )
   125→
   126→
   127→def item_explain(item: dict) -> dict:
   128→    effective_tier = int(item.get("effective_tier", item.get("tier", 3)))
   129→
   130→    if item.get("kind") == "subjective_dimension":
   131→        return {
   132→            "kind": "subjective_dimension",
   133→            "effective_tier": effective_tier,
   134→            "subjective_score": subjective_score_value(item),
   135→            "policy": (
   136→                "Subjective dimensions are always queued as T4 and do not outrank "
   137→                "mechanical T1/T2/T3 items."
   138→            ),
   139→            "ranking_factors": ["tier asc", "subjective_score asc", "id asc"],
   140→        }
   141→
   142→    detail = detail_dict(item)
   143→    confidence = item.get("confidence", "low")
   144→    is_subjective = bool(item.get("is_subjective"))
   145→    is_review = bool(item.get("is_review"))
   146→    ranking_factors: list[str]
   147→    if is_subjective:
   148→        ranking_factors = ["tier fixed to T4", "subjective_score asc", "id asc"]
   149→    elif is_review:
   150→        ranking_factors = [
   151→            "tier asc",
   152→            "confidence asc",
   153→            "review_weight desc",
   154→            "count desc",
   155→            "id asc",
   156→        ]
   157→    else:
   158→        ranking_factors = ["tier asc", "confidence asc", "count desc", "id asc"]
   159→    explain = {
   160→        "kind": "finding",
   161→        "effective_tier": effective_tier,
   162→        "confidence": confidence,
   163→        "confidence_rank": CONFIDENCE_ORDER.get(confidence, 9),
   164→        "count": int(detail.get("count", 0) or 0),
   165→        "id": item.get("id", ""),
   166→        "ranking_factors": ranking_factors,
   167→    }
   168→    if is_review:
   169→        explain["review_weight"] = float(item.get("review_weight", 0.0) or 0.0)
   170→    if is_subjective:
   171→        explain["policy"] = (
   172→            "Subjective findings are forced to T4 and do not outrank "
   173→            "mechanical T1/T2/T3 items."
   174→        )
   175→        explain["subjective_score"] = subjective_score_value(item)
   176→    return explain
   177→
   178→
   179→def tier_counts(items: list[dict]) -> dict[int, int]:
   180→    counts = {1: 0, 2: 0, 3: 0, 4: 0}
   181→    for item in items:
   182→        if item.get("kind") == "cluster":
   183→            # Count each member at its own tier
   184→            for member in item.get("members", []):
   185→                tier = int(member.get("effective_tier", member.get("tier", 3)))
   186→                counts[tier] = counts.get(tier, 0) + 1
   187→            continue
   188→        tier = int(item.get("effective_tier", item.get("tier", 3)))
   189→        counts[tier] = counts.get(tier, 0) + 1
   190→    return counts
   191→
   192→
   193→def choose_fallback_tier(requested_tier: int, counts: dict[int, int]) -> int | None:
   194→    available = [tier for tier, count in counts.items() if count > 0]
   195→    if not available:
   196→        return None
   197→    return min(available, key=lambda tier: (abs(tier - requested_tier), tier))
   198→
   199→
   200→def group_queue_items(items: list[dict], group: str) -> dict[str, list[dict]]:
   201→    """Group queue items for alternate output modes."""
   202→    grouped: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
   203→    for item in items:
   204→        if group == "file":
   205→            key = item.get("file", "")
   206→        elif group == "detector":
   207→            key = item.get("detector", "")
   208→        elif group == "tier":
   209→            key = f"T{int(item.get('effective_tier', item.get('tier', 3)))}"
   210→        elif group == "cluster":
   211→            plan_cluster = item.get("plan_cluster")
   212→            key = plan_cluster["name"] if isinstance(plan_cluster, dict) else "(unclustered)"
   213→        else:
   214→            key = "items"
   215→        grouped.setdefault(key, []).append(item)
   216→    return grouped
   217→
   218→

   211→def _as_non_negative_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
   212→    try:

   219→def ensure_state_defaults(state: StateModel | dict) -> None:
   220→    """Normalize loose/legacy state payloads to a valid base shape in-place."""
   221→    for key, value in empty_state().items():
   222→        state.setdefault(key, value)

   224→    if not isinstance(state.get("findings"), dict):
   225→        state["findings"] = {}

   234→    if not isinstance(state.get("subjective_integrity"), dict):
   235→        state["subjective_integrity"] = {}
   236→
   237→    findings = state["findings"]
   238→    to_remove: list[str] = []
   239→    for finding_id, finding in findings.items():
   240→        if not isinstance(finding, dict):
   241→            to_remove.append(finding_id)
   242→            continue
   243→
   244→        finding.setdefault("id", finding_id)
   245→        finding.setdefault("detector", "unknown")
   246→        finding.setdefault("file", "")
   247→        finding.setdefault("tier", 3)
   248→        finding.setdefault("confidence", "low")

   258→        finding.setdefault("last_seen", finding["first_seen"])
   259→        finding.setdefault("resolved_at", None)
   260→        finding["reopen_count"] = _as_non_negative_int(
   261→            finding.get("reopen_count", 0), default=0
   262→        )
   263→        finding.setdefault("suppressed", False)
   264→        finding.setdefault("suppressed_at", None)
   265→        finding.setdefault("suppression_pattern", None)
   266→
   267→    for finding_id in to_remove:
   268→        findings.pop(finding_id, None)

   270→    for entry in state["scan_history"]:
   271→        if not isinstance(entry, dict):

   273→        integrity = entry.get("subjective_integrity")
   274→        if integrity is not None and not isinstance(integrity, dict):
   275→            entry["subjective_integrity"] = None

   277→    state["scan_count"] = _as_non_negative_int(state.get("scan_count", 0), default=0)

   281→def validate_state_invariants(state: StateModel) -> None:
   282→    """Raise ValueError when core state invariants are violated."""
   283→    if not isinstance(state.get("findings"), dict):
   284→        raise ValueError("state.findings must be a dict")
   285→    if not isinstance(state.get("stats"), dict):
   286→        raise ValueError("state.stats must be a dict")
   287→
   288→    findings = state["findings"]
   289→    for finding_id, finding in findings.items():
   290→        if not isinstance(finding, dict):
   291→            raise ValueError(f"finding {finding_id!r} must be a dict")
   292→        if finding.get("id") != finding_id:
   293→            raise ValueError(f"finding id mismatch for {finding_id!r}")
   294→        if finding.get("status") not in _ALLOWED_FINDING_STATUSES:
   295→            raise ValueError(
   296→                f"finding {finding_id!r} has invalid status {finding.get('status')!r}"
   297→            )
   298→
   299→        tier = finding.get("tier")
   300→        if not isinstance(tier, int) or tier < 1 or tier > 4:
   301→            raise ValueError(f"finding {finding_id!r} has invalid tier {tier!r}")
   302→
   303→        reopen_count = finding.get("reopen_count")
   304→        if not isinstance(reopen_count, int) or reopen_count < 0:
   305→            raise ValueError(

   310→def json_default(obj: Any) -> Any:
   311→    """JSON serializer that handles known types and rejects unknowns."""
   312→    if isinstance(obj, set):
   313→        return sorted(obj)
   314→    if isinstance(obj, Path):
   315→        return str(obj).replace("\\", "/")
   316→    if hasattr(obj, "isoformat"):
   317→        return obj.isoformat()
   318→    raise TypeError(
   319→        f"Object of type {type(obj).__name__} is not JSON serializable: {obj!r}"
   320→    )

1→"""Large file detection (LOC threshold)."""
     2→
     3→import logging
     4→
     5→from pathlib import Path
     6→
     7→from desloppify.base.file_paths import resolve_scan_file
     8→from desloppify.base.fallbacks import log_best_effort_failure
     9→
    10→logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    11→
    12→
    13→def detect_large_files(
    14→    path: Path, file_finder, threshold: int = 500
    15→) -> tuple[list[dict], int]:
    16→    """Find files exceeding a line count threshold."""
    17→    files = file_finder(path)
    18→    entries = []
    19→    for filepath in files:
    20→        try:
    21→            p = resolve_scan_file(filepath, scan_root=path)
    22→            loc = len(p.read_text().splitlines())
    23→            if loc > threshold:
    24→                entries.append({"file": filepath, "loc": loc})
    25→        except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError) as exc:
    26→            log_best_effort_failure(
    27→                logger,
    28→                f"read large-file detector candidate {filepath}",
    29→                exc,
    30→            )
    31→            continue
    32→    return sorted(entries, key=lambda e: -e["loc"]), len(files)
    33→

    56→def _resolve_target_strict_score(config: dict | None) -> tuple[int, str | None]:
    57→    """Resolve strict-score target from config with bounded fallback."""
    58→    raw_target = DEFAULT_TARGET_STRICT_SCORE
    59→    if isinstance(config, dict):
    60→        raw_target = config.get("target_strict_score", DEFAULT_TARGET_STRICT_SCORE)
    61→    try:
    62→        target = int(raw_target)
    63→    except (TypeError, ValueError):
    64→        return (
    65→            DEFAULT_TARGET_STRICT_SCORE,
    66→            (
    67→                f"Invalid config `target_strict_score={raw_target!r}`; using "
    68→                f"{DEFAULT_TARGET_STRICT_SCORE}"
    69→            ),
    70→        )
    71→    if target < MIN_TARGET_STRICT_SCORE or target > MAX_TARGET_STRICT_SCORE:
    72→        return (
    73→            DEFAULT_TARGET_STRICT_SCORE,
    74→            (
    75→                f"Invalid config `target_strict_score={raw_target!r}`; using "
    76→                f"{DEFAULT_TARGET_STRICT_SCORE}"
    77→            ),
    78→        )
    79→    return target, None

    82→def _compute_strict_target(strict_score: float | None, config: dict | None) -> StrictTarget:
    83→    """Build strict-target context for command rendering and agents."""
    84→    target, warning = _resolve_target_strict_score(config)
    85→    if not isinstance(strict_score, int | float):
    86→        return {
    87→            "target": float(target),
    88→            "current": None,
    89→            "gap": None,
    90→            "state": "unavailable",

    94→    current = round(float(strict_score), 1)
    95→    gap = round(float(target) - current, 1)
    96→    if gap > 0:

   111→def _count_open_by_detector(findings: dict) -> dict[str, int]:
   112→    """Count open findings by detector, merging structural sub-detectors.
   113→
   114→    When detector is "review" and detail.holistic is True, also increments
   115→    "review_holistic" for separate holistic counting.
   116→    """
   117→    by_detector: dict[str, int] = {}
   118→    for f in findings.values():
   119→        if f["status"] != "open" or f.get("suppressed"):
   120→            continue
   121→        detector = f.get("detector", "unknown")
   122→        if detector in STRUCTURAL_MERGE:
   123→            detector = "structural"
   124→        by_detector[detector] = by_detector.get(detector, 0) + 1
   125→        # Track holistic review findings separately
   126→        if detector == "review" and f.get("detail", {}).get("holistic"):
   127→            by_detector["review_holistic"] = by_detector.get("review_holistic", 0) + 1
   128→    # Track uninvestigated review findings (only when review findings exist)
   129→    if by_detector.get("review", 0) > 0:
   130→        by_detector["review_uninvestigated"] = sum(
   131→            1
   132→            for f in findings.values()
   133→            if f.get("status") == "open"
   134→            and not f.get("suppressed")
   135→            and f.get("detector") == "review"
   136→            and not f.get("detail", {}).get("investigation")
   137→        )
   138→    return by_detector

   175→    in_readme = False
   176→    if generated:
   177→        for readme_name in ("README.md", "readme.md", "README.MD"):
   178→            readme_path = project_root / readme_name
   179→            if readme_path.exists():
   180→                try:
   181→                    in_readme = scorecard_rel in readme_path.read_text(
   182→                        encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"
   183→                    )
   184→                except OSError:
   185→                    in_readme = False
   186→                break
   187→
   188→    recommendation = None
   189→    if generated and not in_readme:
   190→        recommendation = (
   191→            f'Add to README: <img src="{scorecard_rel}" width="100%">'
   192→        )
   193→
   194→    return {
   195→        "generated": generated,
   196→        "in_readme": in_readme,
   197→        "path": scorecard_rel,
   198→        "recommendation": recommendation,
   199→    }
   200→
   201→
   202→def _compute_primary_action(actions: list[dict]) -> PrimaryAction | None:
   203→    """Pick the highest-priority action for user-facing guidance."""
   204→    if not actions:
   205→        return None
   206→    top = actions[0]
   207→    command = str(top.get("command", "")).strip()
   208→    if not command:
   209→        return None
   210→    description = str(top.get("description", "")).strip() or "run highest-impact action"
   211→    return {
   212→        "command": command,
   213→        "description": description,
   214→    }
   215→
   216→
   217→def _compute_why_now(
   218→    phase: str,
   219→    strategy: dict[str, object],
   220→    primary_action: dict | None,
   221→) -> str:
   222→    """Explain why the recommended action should happen now."""
   223→    hint = str(strategy.get("hint", "")).strip() if isinstance(strategy, dict) else ""
   224→    if hint:
   225→        return hint
   226→    if primary_action and primary_action.get("description"):
   227→        return str(primary_action["description"])
   228→    phase_default = {
   229→        "first_scan": "Start with highest-impact findings to establish a clean baseline.",
   230→        "regression": "Recent regressions should be contained before new work.",
   231→        "stagnation": "Current approach is stalling; tackle a different high-impact lane.",
   232→        "maintenance": "Keep the codebase stable by resolving new risk quickly.",
   233→    }
   234→    return phase_default.get(phase, "Address the highest-impact open findings first.")
   235→
   236→
   237→def _compute_verification_step(_command: str | None) -> VerificationStep:
   238→    """Verification step returned with every narrative plan."""
   239→    return {
   240→        "command": "desloppify scan",
   241→        "reason": "revalidate after changes",
   242→    }
   243→
   244→
   245→def _compute_risk_flags(state: StateModel, debt: dict) -> list[RiskFlag]:
   246→    """Build ordered risk flags from suppression and wontfix debt signals."""
   247→    flags: list[RiskFlag] = []
   248→
   249→    ignore_integrity = state.get("ignore_integrity", {})
   250→    suppressed_pct = float(ignore_integrity.get("suppressed_pct", 0.0) or 0.0)
   251→    ignored_count = int(ignore_integrity.get("ignored", 0) or 0)
   252→    if (
   253→        suppressed_pct >= _HIGH_IGNORE_SUPPRESSION_THRESHOLD
   254→        or ignored_count >= 100
   255→    ):
   256→        severity = "high" if suppressed_pct >= 40.0 or ignored_count >= 200 else "medium"
   257→        message = (
   258→            f"{suppressed_pct:.1f}% findings hidden by ignore patterns"
   259→            if suppressed_pct > 0
   260→            else f"{ignored_count} findings hidden by ignore patterns"
   261→        )
   262→        flags.append(
   263→            {
   264→                "type": "high_ignore_suppression",
   265→                "severity": severity,
   266→                "message": message,
   267→            }
   268→        )
   269→
   270→    wontfix_count = int(debt.get("wontfix_count", 0) or 0)
   271→    overall_gap = float(debt.get("overall_gap", 0.0) or 0.0)
   272→    if overall_gap >= _WONTFIX_GAP_THRESHOLD or wontfix_count > 0:
   273→        severity = "high" if overall_gap >= 5.0 or wontfix_count >= 50 else "medium"
   274→        flags.append(
   275→            {
   276→                "type": "wontfix_gap",
   277→                "severity": severity,
   278→                "message": (
   279→                    f"Strict/lenient gap is {overall_gap:.1f} pts with "
   280→                    f"{wontfix_count} wontfix findings"
   281→                ),
   282→            }
   283→        )
   284→
   285→    flags.sort(key=lambda flag: _RISK_SEVERITY_ORDER.get(flag.get("severity"), 99))
   286→    return flags
   287→
   288→
   289→@dataclass(frozen=True)
   290→class NarrativeContext:
   291→    """Optional context inputs for narrative computation."""
   292→
   293→    diff: dict | None = None
   294→    lang: str | None = None
   295→    command: str | None = None
   296→    config: dict | None = None
   297→    plan: dict | None = None
   298→
   299→def _history_for_lang(raw_history: list[dict], lang: str | None) -> list[dict]:
   300→    if not lang:
   301→        return raw_history
   302→    return [entry for entry in raw_history if entry.get("lang") in (lang, None)]
   303→
   304→
   305→def _scoped_findings(state: StateModel) -> dict[str, Finding]:
   306→    return path_scoped_findings(
   307→        state.get("findings", {}), state.get("scan_path")
   308→    )
   309→
   310→
   311→def _score_snapshot(state: StateModel) -> tuple[float | None, float | None]:
   312→    return get_strict_score(state), get_overall_score(state)
   313→
   314→
   315→def compute_narrative(
   316→    state: StateModel,
   317→    context: NarrativeContext | None = None,
   318→) -> NarrativeResult:
   319→    """Compute structured narrative context from state data."""
   320→    resolved_context = context or NarrativeContext()
   321→
   322→    diff = resolved_context.diff
   323→    lang = resolved_context.lang
   324→    command = resolved_context.command
   325→    config = resolved_context.config
   326→    plan = resolved_context.plan
   327→
   328→    raw_history = state.get("scan_history", [])
   329→    history = _history_for_lang(raw_history, lang)
   330→    dim_scores = state.get("dimension_scores", {})
   331→    stats = state.get("stats", {})
   332→    strict_score, overall_score = _score_snapshot(state)
   333→    findings = _scoped_findings(state)
   334→
   335→    by_detector = _count_open_by_detector(findings)
   336→    badge = _compute_badge_status()
   337→
   338→    phase = _detect_phase(history, strict_score)
   339→    dimensions = _analyze_dimensions(dim_scores, history, state)
   340→    debt = _analyze_debt(dim_scores, findings, history)
   341→    milestone = _detect_milestone(state, None, history)
   342→    clusters = plan.get("clusters") if isinstance(plan, dict) else None
   343→    action_context = ActionContext(
   344→        by_detector=by_detector,
   345→        dimension_scores=dim_scores,
   346→        state=state,
   347→        debt=debt,
   348→        lang=lang,
   349→        clusters=clusters,
   350→    )
   351→    actions = [dict(action) for action in compute_actions(action_context)]
   352→    strategy = compute_strategy(findings, by_detector, actions, phase, lang)
   353→    tools = dict(compute_tools(by_detector, state, lang, badge))
   354→    primary_action = _compute_primary_action(actions)
   355→    why_now = _compute_why_now(phase, strategy, primary_action)
   356→    verification_step = _compute_verification_step(command)
   357→    risk_flags = _compute_risk_flags(state, debt)
   358→    strict_target = _compute_strict_target(strict_score, config)
   359→    headline = _compute_headline(
   360→        phase,
   361→        dimensions,
   362→        debt,
   363→        milestone,
   364→        diff,
   365→        strict_score,
   366→        overall_score,
   367→        stats,
   368→        history,
   369→        open_by_detector=by_detector,
   370→    )
   371→    reminders, updated_reminder_history = _compute_reminders(
   372→        state, lang, phase, debt, actions, dimensions, badge, command, config=config
   373→    )
   374→
   375→    return {
   376→        "phase": phase,
   377→        "headline": headline,
   378→        "dimensions": dimensions,
   379→        "actions": actions,
   380→        "strategy": strategy,
   381→        "tools": tools,
   382→        "debt": debt,
   383→        "milestone": milestone,
   384→        "primary_action": primary_action,

   388→        "strict_target": strict_target,

    33→
    34→# Mechanical detectors → subjective dimensions they provide evidence for.
    35→# When findings from these detectors change during a scan, the corresponding
    36→# subjective assessments are marked stale so reviewers know to re-evaluate.
    37→_DETECTOR_SUBJECTIVE_DIMENSIONS: dict[str, tuple[str, ...]] = {
    38→    "structural": ("design_coherence", "abstraction_fitness"),
    39→    "smells": ("design_coherence", "error_consistency"),
    40→    "global_mutable_config": ("initialization_coupling",),
